high.title: Economists Adjust Inflation Projections for 8th Consecutive Week; See This Monday's (4th) Focus Survey
high.summary:
Economists surveyed by Brazil's Central Bank have adjusted inflation projections for the eighth consecutive week, according to the Focus Bulletin released Monday morning. IPCA expectations for 2026 rose from 4.86% to 4.89%, moving outside the Central Bank's inflation target tolerance band. Projections for 2027 and 2029 remained at 4% and 3.50% respectively, while 2028 estimates increased from 3.61% to 3.64%.

Selic rate forecasts remained unchanged at 13% for this year and 11% for 2027, staying at 10% for 2028. However, 2029 expectations rose from 9.75% to 10%. USD/BRL exchange rate projections point to R$5.25 at year-end, with subsequent years forecasted at R$5.30 (2027), R$5.39 (2028), and R$5.40 (2029).

This marks a concerning trend of persistent upward inflation revisions, suggesting the market sees structural price pressures that could force the Central Bank to maintain restrictive monetary policy longer than previously anticipated. The inflation projections breaching the target tolerance band signals potential policy tightening ahead.

medium.title: Mother's Day Approaching: Know Whether It's Time to Buy or Sell Retail Stocks in the Season When 'Everything Shines'
medium.summary: The article discusses retail sector performance ahead of Mother's Day, noting that despite Selic rate cuts from 14.75% to 14.50%, consumption still feels the effects of high interest rates. The market has become more selective with retail investments, requiring companies to not just sell more but sell profitably. UBS BB downgraded fashion retailer Azzas (AZZA3) from buy to neutral, cutting the target price from R$33 to R$25, though still showing 16% upside potential.
